findings.note: AnchorInDiff verifies file membership strictly but line anchoring only via range intersection: a well-formed entry citing a deliberately over-broad range (e.g. start_line=1, end_line=999999) for a file present in the diff passes the anchor gate. This is inherent to the lab-ported range-intersection contract (±10 slack documented at lensoutput.go:29-34); the gate targets fabricated file/line citations from non-adversarial lens output, not adversarial range inflation. Documented contract behavior, non-blocking.

findings.note: The apply path now recomputes the diff (nodeDiff) for every kind before decoding, even kinds whose Decode does not need a diff; a git.Diff failure at apply time fails the advance for plain kinds where it previously could not. Deliberate (the machine_test.go:2415-2452 diffFailGit test pins the failure surfacing) and fail-closed rather than fail-open; non-blocking.
